message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "characterization", "trigger": "When evaluating a solitary soft tissue density or mass in the paratracheal region on a chest X-ray to determine its etiology.", "steps": ["Inspect the margins of the paratracheal opacity to determine if they are smooth and well-defined versus irregular, spiculated, or ill-defined.", "Scan the interior of the density for specific internal features such as calcifications (suggesting granuloma) or air-fluid levels (suggesting abscess).", "Correlate the morphological findings: a smooth, well-circumscribed, non-calcified soft tissue density in this location is characteristic of a benign congenital lesion like a bronchogenic cyst, whereas irregular margins suggest malignancy and fluid levels suggest infection."]}]}
